U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio held separate meetings with Qatar's Prime Minister in Washington as diplomatic efforts to end the nearly nine-month-old conflict with Iran remain stalled. Meanwhile, Tehran has warned that it will use all available means to counter the U.S. naval blockade of its ports. What role can Qatar play in preventing further escalation?
Thank you for watching our video!
